notes: Unix targets should be published as compressed archives containing the binary.
macOS targets should be published as compressed archives containing the binary.
Windows targets should use `.exe` binaries and zip packaging.
uv builds one wheel and source distribution in a fresh temporary directory; only fresh assets are copied and released.
Python package builds use outputDir and checksumFile with no target suffix override or target matrix.
Cargo package verification stays enabled; only selected crates produced in the fresh target directory are copied and released. No crates.io publication.
Rust binaries reuse Go naming and archive policies. Cargo compiler JSON identifies executables. Windows binary assets end in .exe.

Native macOS or GNU/Linux only; SwiftPM release executable path is discovered with --show-bin-path. Fresh assets reuse Rust/Go naming. Resource bundles and package-built shared libraries are rejected. Runtime libraries are not bundled.
